findings.issue: כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂרַף is 3ms “as he burned,” and אֵת marks הַפָּר הָרִאשׁוֹן as the object. “conforme a lo que quemó el toro el primero” makes the bull the subject of quemó and the relative the thing burned.
findings.spanishSpan: conforme a lo que quemó el toro el primero

notes: The other clauses match the weqatal, objects, prepositions, and the verbless חַטַּאת הַקָּהָל הוּא.
